about.title: About me
about.description: I completed two different fields of study and earned the titles of Engineer and Project Manager. My interest in programming and frontend technologies started during that period. After graduation, I expanded my web development knowledge through many online courses and by creating my own concepts, which you can find in the projects section. This allowed me to learn a variety of frontend technologies and gain the skills required to build modern user interfaces. In private life, I strongly focus on self-development and effective time management. I believe that disciplined time management and consistency are the keys to continuous growth.

list.title: Calories Counter
list.description: This application helps you calculate your calorie needs and track your daily calorie intake. It was built with Angular v17 and a more traditional modular architecture based mainly on services and RxJS for state management. Data is stored in the cloud using the Firebase API.

list.title: Progress Counter
list.description: This application lets you analyze your strength progress. It allows setting individual workouts, adding exercises, and analyzing charts related to your achievements. It was built with Angular v17 using a modern approach based on standalone components and signals. NgRx Signal Store is used for state management. Data is stored in the cloud using the Firebase API.

list.title: Portfolio
list.description: A portfolio website containing key information intended to present me as a Front End Developer and encourage collaboration. It was built with React. Data is stored in Redux store and used across the app. Material UI was used to speed up component development. The application does not communicate with a backend.
